title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-06-24
source: (no source info given- listeners report AUD)

ai_review.summary: A legendary June‑24‑70 show with standout Alligator→Other One jams and Attics, but captured only in poor‑quality audience recordings.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the performance – the ferocious Alligator > Other One jam, multiple Attics renditions, a superb Cold Rain & Snow, and a sweet second Dark Star make this night a “peak” show.  The recording, however, is an audience tape with limited fidelity, occasional muddiness and missing soundboard clarity, though some moments (the gun‑shot/ fireworks on "Man & My Uncle") are captured vividly.

ai_rating.rationale: The consensus is that the musical performance rates very highly (≈4.5/5) while the audio quality is low (≈2/5); weighting these yields an overall rating around 3.8.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No soundboard source; listeners note muddy, low‑fidelity sound and frequent comments about ‘not great’ SQ, but occasional clarity on specific moments (gun‑shot/fireworks).

standout_songs: Good Lovin' > China > Rider > Good Lovin'
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early set highlighted by Cold Rain, Easy Wind and Minglewood; the second set builds with an intense Alligator > Other One jam, multiple Attics appearances, and a soaring Dark Star, giving the night a dynamic rise‑and‑fall that fans call the “peak night.”
